title: A wedding on car 14
watchFor: Kesh and Teo are engaged for this run and marry on Kesh's own car: they say their own vows, with Rook and Tam as witnesses. The director only plays it; when the scene ends, the tie check should read the vows and end fiancé, add spouse, with each side's word right for their pronouns (Kesh's word for Teo is husband, Teo's for Kesh is wife); the game mirrors it. Both should come out with a Core memory of the wedding (forced by the tie event). Scene 2, the next evening at the Sump Lantern, should treat them as married: their sheets show spouse.
turns: I stand in the aisle between the seats. "You asked me to witness this, so I'm witnessing. Whenever you're ready."
"Kesh, Teo: say your vows. The car's listening."
"Tam, you're the other witness. You heard them both?"
I sign the back of a transit chit as witness and hand it to Kesh. "That's it, then. Married. Congratulations, both of you."
I raise my glass. "To the newlyweds!"
"Kesh, how does it feel, being someone's wife?"
